profile.name: Filip
profile.role: I build dependable software for complex problems.
profile.intro: I’m a software engineer who turns complex technical challenges into reliable, scalable products. From backend systems and cloud solutions to machine learning, I combine analytical thinking with practical engineering to build software that delivers measurable results.

about.title: Engineering with clarity and purpose.
paragraphs: I’m a software engineer with more than eight years of experience building reliable web applications, backend systems, cloud solutions, and machine-learning products. I enjoy working on technically demanding problems where thoughtful architecture, strong analytical skills, and measurable results make a real difference.

My approach combines practical engineering with clear communication and continuous improvement. I care about maintainable code, dependable delivery, and choosing technology based on the problem—not trends. I also enjoy sharing knowledge, mentoring developers, and helping teams turn complex requirements into focused, effective solutions.

skills.title: Tools for solving the right problems.

contact.description: I’m always open to discussing challenging engineering roles, ambitious products, and meaningful collaborations. If you think we could build something valuable together, I’d be glad to hear from you.

projects.name: Auto Solver
projects.description: Web application for auto-scheduling manager's schedule and optimizing the result. The position required full-stack technologies, an understanding of the cloud, and advanced mathematics. I developed a solver that was only 5% slower than the best one available while providing results of over 40% higher quality on average. I designed, developed, and deployed key backend functionality, ensured smooth cloud operation, and later mentored junior software developers.

projects.name: Cropsit
projects.description: A web and mobile application for detecting anomalies in plants using deep neural networks for leaf classification. I designed and implemented backend systems, creating APIs and services that enabled communication between the front-end interface, databases, and various microservices.

projects.name: Digital Advertising Platform
projects.description: I developed backend functionality for a web server that communicated with remote digital advertising displays, managed external API calls, and uploaded video playback results to a cloud-based solution for centralized tracking and analysis.

projects.name: ECG Signal Research
projects.description: I researched and trained custom deep neural networks for the classification and synthesis of one-dimensional medical ECG signals to automate recognition of heart anomalies. The project aimed to expand the classification dataset by synthesizing additional data through adjustments to state-of-the-art models.

projects.name: Ramsas 1.5

projects.name: Ambit RISK
projects.description: Developed fintech web solutions as part of an external development team for FIS. Ambit RISK is a monolithic application focused on migrating existing desktop functionality to a modern web-based solution.

projects.name: Prophet
projects.description: Contributed to a microservice-based fintech platform involving AI chatbot development, financial modeling, and workspace-related microservices as part of an external development team for FIS.
